rationale_md: The United States enters this Group D clash with a 50-point Elo advantage over Australia, positioning them as narrow favorites to claim all three points in what should be a competitive encounter. While the Americans hold the technical edge on paper, the relatively modest rating gap suggests Australia possesses enough quality to frustrate their opponents, making this a genuine toss-up despite the home continent advantage for the U.S. Both sides will view this as a critical opportunity to establish early momentum in what could be a tightly contested group.
